name: Summer Camp at AFS
description_short: Day camp on the Abington Friends School campus for ages 3 to 12, in four groups by age. Every camper swims daily in the school's pools with lessons by ability, and older campers rotate through sports, archery, karate, drama, music, dance and art, then pick electives each afternoon.
notes: Campers must be 3 by September 1, 2026. Families pack a snack and lunch each day. A counselor in training program is open to campers entering high school. No prices, hours or extended care details on the page; summer 2027 dates are not posted yet.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Summer camp page: 2026 camp dates June 22 to July 31, 2026, ages 3 to 12 in Early Childhood (3), Junior (4 to 5), Senior (6 to 9) and Camp Endeavor (10 to 12). Daily instructional swim; activities rotate indoors and outdoors. Parents provide snack and lunch, so meals_included is false. Address and phone from the school footer; email is the camp contact named on the page.
